rules: Low cohesion is not proof of violence.
High tension does not automatically create civil war; Block 3 owns armed-conflict simulation.
Fragmentation requires explicit political/institutional causes and cannot be rolled solely from species/culture.
Multiple polities may remain part of one civilization identity while holding independent governments/relations.
Durable successor-civilization creation requires lineage rules and an explicit authoritative transition.
First Contact may alter political pressures, but cannot invent a planetary unity or fracture without causes.
